input: How many changes (edits and page creations combined) does the edits dataset contain?

checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM edits

input: How many distinct wikis appear in the edits dataset?

checks.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT wiki) FROM edits

input: How many distinct accounts made changes in the edits dataset?

checks.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT editor) FROM edits

input: Which three wikis have the most changes in the edits dataset? Give their wiki database names.

checks.sql: SELECT wiki FROM edits GROUP BY wiki ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 3

input: Counting only changes by human (non-bot) accounts, which wiki has the most changes?

checks.sql: SELECT wiki FROM edits WHERE NOT is_bot GROUP BY wiki ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

input: What share of all changes in the edits dataset were made by bot accounts?

checks.sql: SELECT avg(CASE WHEN is_bot THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FROM edits

input: On enwiki, what share of changes were made by bots?

checks.sql: SELECT avg(CASE WHEN is_bot THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FROM edits WHERE wiki = 'enwiki'

input: How many new pages were created in the edits dataset?

checks.sql: SELECT sum(CASE WHEN event_type = 'new' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM edits

input: Which wiki had the second-highest number of new pages created?

checks.sql: SELECT wiki FROM edits GROUP BY wiki ORDER BY sum(CASE WHEN event_type = 'new' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

input: Bucket the edits dataset by UTC hour. How many changes happened in the busiest hour?

checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM edits GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', event_time) ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

input: In the edits_per_minute mart, what is the largest number of changes a single wiki had in one minute?

checks.sql: SELECT max(edits) FROM edits_per_minute

input: How many bytes were added in total across all changes in the edits dataset?

checks.sql: SELECT sum(CASE WHEN length_delta > 0 THEN length_delta ELSE 0 END) FROM edits

input: How many editing sessions are recorded in the editor_sessions dataset?

checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM editor_sessions

input: What is the average number of edits per session for human (non-bot) sessions in editor_sessions?

checks.sql: SELECT avg(edits) FROM editor_sessions WHERE NOT is_bot

input: In the daily session statistics mart, what is the highest median session length in minutes for human sessions on any wiki?

checks.sql: SELECT max(median_session_minutes) FROM editor_sessions_daily WHERE NOT is_bot

input: According to the daily session statistics mart, which wiki had the most human (non-bot) sessions?

checks.sql: SELECT wiki FROM editor_sessions_daily WHERE NOT is_bot GROUP BY wiki ORDER BY sum(sessions) DESC LIMIT 1

input: What is the title of the most trending article?

checks.sql: SELECT title FROM trending_articles ORDER BY trend_rank LIMIT 1

input: How many of the trending articles are on enwiki?

checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM trending_articles WHERE wiki = 'enwiki'

input: How many changes in the edits dataset were made to the number one trending article (same wiki and title)?

checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM edits e JOIN trending_articles t ON e.wiki = t.wiki AND e.title = t.title WHERE t.trend_rank = 1

input.question: How many changes have an edit summary (comment) that mentions 'revert', case-insensitive?

checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM edits WHERE comment ILIKE '%revert%'

input: How many changes on enwiki were in the article namespace (namespace 0)?

checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM edits WHERE wiki = 'enwiki' AND namespace = 0

input: List the usernames of the top 5 human editors by number of changes.

checks.sql: SELECT editor FROM edits WHERE NOT is_bot GROUP BY editor ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 5
